This '''commander''' in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] was placed in command of the infamous [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Red Wind]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The ship and her commander became notorious for committing a number of atrocities during their battles against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. In the months following the Rebels' [[evacuation of Yavin]], the [[Red Wind]] was stopped near planet [[Plooriod IV]], undergoing repairs. Support ships surrounded it with a mine field to protect it. [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian Corvette]] crews urged an attack to seek out retribution by destroying the ship. [[A-wing]] fighters led by [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] made a path through the mine field for nine corvettes during the [[Attack on the Red Wind|attack]]. After a long battle, the frigate was destroyed, presumably along with its commander.
